Remark
[Kahler analogue] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0146 1. ch20:20.3\group Asymptotic Geometry

The analogous statement holds for a nonflat ancient Kahler--Ricci flow with bounded nonnegative bisectional curvature: its asymptotic volume ratio is zero at every time.
